<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-france-most-cautious-market" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/france-most-cautious-market/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="France is the most cautious market on enterprise AI, and the least prepared." markdown>

**France is the most cautious market on enterprise AI, and the least prepared.** In an FTI Consulting survey of 1,600 senior decision-makers across seven markets, 34% of French respondents favour a cautious, control-first approach, the highest share. France nonetheless ranks last on employee training (26%), written AI policies (28%) and risk assessment before project launch (37%). Across all markets, 60% slowed, paused or cancelled a planned AI deployment in the past 12 months. [L'Usine Digitale, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.usine-digitale.fr/intelligence-artificielle/ia-en-entreprise-la-france-championne-de-la-prudence-mais-derniere-sur-la-formation-des-salaries-et-levaluation-des-risques.JMLVNUU4ZJH4PASD5R3RRP54ZE.html) · [FTI Consulting release, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.fticonsulting.com/fr-fr/france/newsroom/large-companies-slowing-down-adoption-ai)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-gartner-13-percent-cios-value" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/gartner-13-percent-cios-value/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="Only 13% of CIOs report significant AI value, and stop rules separate the leaders." markdown>

**Only 13% of CIOs report significant AI value, and stop rules separate the leaders.** In Gartner's survey of 2,002 CIOs and technology executives, organisations with guidelines for when a pilot should not move to production are 2.3 times more likely to be "vanguards", yet only 31% have them. The figures are self-reported and show an association, not a cause. [Gartner, 19 Oct 2026](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-10-19-gartner-survey-finds-only-13-percent-of-cios-say-their-enterprise-has-realized-significant-or-transformational-value-from-ai)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-lawyers-ai-use-fees" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/lawyers-ai-use-fees/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="In a billable-hours profession, AI use rose to 55% but only 26% cut fees." markdown>

**In a billable-hours profession, AI use rose to 55% but only 26% cut fees.** A census of 2,221 lawyers by Victoria's legal regulator shows fee cuts are more common for business clients (34%) than for individuals (23%). The co-author says gains were lower than expected, possibly offset by verification, and 41% of lawyers now receive AI-generated client documents that need correcting. These are lawyers, not consultants. [The Guardian, 30 Oct 2026](https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/oct/30/victorian-lawyers-ai-clients-fees)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-french-pmos-use-ai" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/french-pmos-use-ai/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="French PMOs use AI for reporting, rarely for risk or portfolio decisions." markdown>

**French PMOs use AI for reporting, rarely for risk or portfolio decisions.** Virage Group's 2026 PMO Observatory finds 73% use AI regularly and 85% name reporting time as the main benefit, but 84% do not use it to monitor the portfolio or produce recommendations. Confidentiality (63%) and sovereignty (52%) are the main barriers. The sample is 73 respondents, recruited among a tool vendor's clients and prospects. [Le Monde Informatique, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.lemondeinformatique.fr/actualites/lire-73-des-pmo-utilisent-l-ia-mais-moins-de-10-anticipent-les-risques-100859.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-two-thirds-french-companies" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/two-thirds-french-companies/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Two-thirds of French companies use generative AI; one-third see productivity gains." markdown>

**Two-thirds of French companies use generative AI; one-third see productivity gains.** In a Banque de France survey of about 7,000 firms, more than two-thirds of those with over 20 employees use generative AI tools, yet only a third report productivity gains. It blames experimental uses and imperfect integration into production processes. [AFP via Boursorama, 3 Sep 2026](https://www.boursorama.com/actualite-economique/actualites/ia-dans-les-entreprises-une-adoption-rapide-sans-effet-immediat-sur-la-productivite-c93eaecaf24c5eacb01ec56fcba787af)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-us-companies-bypass-governance" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/us-companies-bypass-governance/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Nearly half of large US companies have bypassed their own AI governance." markdown>

**Nearly half of large US companies have bypassed their own AI governance.** In an EY survey of 202 senior leaders at $1bn+ public companies, 47% said their organisation had skipped its governance process for an urgent deployment. 49% have not updated their framework for agentic AI risks, and 26% could not detect unauthorised agents operating internally. [TechInformed, 23 Sep 2026](https://techinformed.com/nearly-half-of-big-us-firms-have-bypassed-ai-governance/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-french-consulting-price-pressure" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/french-consulting-price-pressure/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Two-thirds of French consulting and agency leaders have been asked to cut prices because of AI." markdown>

**Two-thirds of French consulting and agency leaders have been asked to cut prices because of AI.** In an OpinionWay poll of 300 leaders of agencies, consulting firms and IT-services companies, 66% have received client requests for lower fees on the grounds that AI should mechanically reduce production costs; for 15% the requests are now regular. Commissioned by Furious, a listing platform for these firms. [Stratégies, 22 Sep 2026](https://www.strategies.fr/actualites/culture-tech/LQ6616484C/ia-les-cabinets-de-conseil-face-la-question-des-tarifs.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-french-consulting-branch-ai-barometer" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/french-consulting-branch-ai-barometer/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="In France&#x27;s engineering and consulting branch, nine firms in ten use AI and 47% have no rules." markdown>

**In France's engineering and consulting branch, nine firms in ten use AI and 47% have no rules.** The first OPIIEC barometer (606 firms) puts average AI maturity at 47/100 and finds only 29% have named an AI lead. Data security and compliance weigh most heavily in engineering studies and consulting, where client trust conditions any deployment. [Solutions Numériques, 16 Sep 2026](https://www.solutions-numeriques.com/ia-dans-les-bureaux-detudes-90-des-entreprises-ont-franchi-le-cap-la-gouvernance-reste-a-construire/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-gartner-ai-portfolio-returns" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/gartner-ai-portfolio-returns/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Gartner: the organisations getting returns from AI manage it as a portfolio." markdown>

**Gartner: the organisations getting returns from AI manage it as a portfolio.** In a survey of 1,303 respondents, only 22% of organisations had scaled AI across multiple business units. High performers track returns continuously, manage initiatives as a portfolio and stop underperforming projects; they report positive returns on 81% of initiatives. [TechInformed, 4 Sep 2026](https://techinformed.com/gartner-finds-only-22-have-successfully-scaled-ai/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-half-euro-area-employees" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/half-euro-area-employees/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Half of euro-area employees now use AI, but the productivity gain is conditional." markdown>

**Half of euro-area employees now use AI, but the productivity gain is conditional.** An ECB note of 26 August puts usage at 52% of employees, up from 26% in 2024, with users reporting three hours saved per week. The bank warns that the gain only materialises if firms convert that time into output, service quality or innovation, a shift not all of them have started. [La Tribune, 26 Aug 2026](https://www.latribune.fr/article/tech/intelligence-artificielle/32821203213850/ia-au-bureau-trois-heures-gagnees-par-semaine-mais-le-miracle-productif-attendra)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-gallup-organizational-adoption-jump" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/gallup-organizational-adoption-jump/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="Gallup measured a six-point quarterly jump in organisational AI adoption in the US." markdown>

**Gallup measured a six-point quarterly jump in organisational AI adoption in the US.** In the second quarter of 2026, 47% of US employees said their organisation had integrated AI tools, up from 41% the quarter before; 52% use AI in their role and 15% use it daily. The most common uses are not the ones rated most productive: 77% of those using AI for coding or automation report a positive effect, against 68% for writing and editing. [Gallup, 20 Jul 2026](https://www.gallup.com/workplace/712736/organizational-adoption-jumps-six-points.aspx)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-governance-gap-at-top" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/governance-gap-at-top/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="AI governance gaps start at the top of the organisation." markdown>

**AI governance gaps start at the top of the organisation.** A Deloitte survey of Society for Corporate Governance members at 92 public and 14 private companies found that most lack board-specific AI policies, and that nearly half of the public companies have not formally enabled or standardised AI for board work. Separately, a survey by Microsoft partner TrustedTech reports that nearly two-thirds of senior decision-makers admit to using unapproved AI tools, against 31% of lower-level employees. [Deloitte, 21 Jul 2026](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/programs/center-for-board-effectiveness/articles/board-of-director-ai-use.html) · [CIO.com, 15 Jul 2026](https://www.cio.com/article/4195782/senior-executives-abuse-shadow-ai-twice-as-much-as-regular-employees-do.html)
